title: KEN_IE001
source: Part 2: an exciting activity you have tried for the first time

qs: Are you a student?
What subjects are you studying?
Which subject do you like most? Why?
Do you prefer to study in the morning or in the afternoon? Why?
Do you often stay up late?
Did you stay up late when you were a kid?
What do you do when you stay up late?
What does it feel like the next morning if you stay up late?
Do you often talk to elderly people?
Do you enjoy spending time with elderly people?
How do you feel about getting old?

card: Describe an exciting activity you have tried for the first time.
– Why you thought it was exciting
And explain how you felt about it
round: Have you talked to anyone about this experience?
Would you like to have a similar experience again?

p3: Why are some people unwilling to try new things?
Why are some people keen on doing dangerous activities?
Do you think children adapt to new things more easily than adults?

title: KEN_IE002
source: Part 2: an interesting traditional story

qs: Where is your hometown?
What kind of place is it?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
Have you ever borrowed books from others?
Have you ever borrowed money from others?
Do you like to lend things to others?
How do you feel when people don't return things they borrowed from you?
What kind of clothes do you like to wear?
Do you prefer to wear comfortable and casual clothes or smart clothes?
Do you like wearing T-shirts?
Do you spend a lot of time choosing clothes?

card: And explain how you felt when you first heard it
round: Have you recommended it to anyone?
Would you like to watch or hear something similar again?

p3: What kind of stories do children like to listen to?
What can a child learn from a story?

title: KEN_IE003
source: Part 2: a natural place (for example, park, mountains)

qs: Tell me about the kind of accommodation you live in.
Who do you live with?
Which room do you like most in your home? Why?
Would you like to move to a different home in the future?
Did you like going to parks as a child?
Do you still like going to parks now?
Would you like to see more parks in your city?
Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?
Have you ever learnt anything about space and the stars when you were at school?
Would you like to know more about space and the stars?
Do you like science-fiction movies set in space?
Do you want to go into outer space in the future?

card: Describe a natural place (for example, park, mountains).
– Why you want to go there
round: Have you told other people about this place?
Would you like to visit this place again in the future?

p3: What kind of people like to visit natural places?
